why: The Washington County moratorium (ORD-2026-12) is in effect from June 30, 2026 through June 30, 2027 and pauses acceptance, processing, reviewing, and approval of all data center applications countywide, which the findings confirm applies to the site. Because the moratorium blocks all local data center permitting activity during this period, the project cannot secure necessary county approvals as of the as-of date 2026-10-25. Separately, the project's assumed 121 diesel generators (2,500 kW each, total 302.5 MW) yield an estimated NOx potential-to-emit of 1,067 tpy, exceeding the 100 tpy major-source threshold under 40 CFR 70.2, triggering a federal Title V operating permit requirement. The Title V permit adds a major federal air-permitting obligation that compounds the local moratorium barrier. With the county moratorium actively blocking local approvals and a major federal air permit required, the project cannot proceed now.
